cases.why: Core A2-01 firing: an in-scope suppressed line makes the scope incomplete and, with no positive evidence, an active earlyoom then reads KILLERS_UNKNOWN exit 2. Rule A2-01 (round-27/contract.md:49) says a journald `Suppressed N messages from earlyoom.service` line in scope sets scope_complete false; the rule was adopted as A1b in round-26/contract.md:158-159. Journal record 1 is the invocation's version line `earlyoom 1.9.0` at 42000000, exactly ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic=42000000, so it is inside the scope (round-26/contract.md:78-79: scope is the current invocation's lines in the current boot whose __MONOTONIC_TIMESTAMP is >= ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic; the version line is main.c:161 `fprintf(stderr, "earlyoom " VERSION "\n")` at earlyoom v1.9.0). Journal record 2, `Suppressed 42 messages from earlyoom.service` at 42001234, is also inside the scope, so scope_complete is false (round-26/contract.md:92-93 defines scope_complete as true only when the version line of the current invocation is inside the scope; A2-01 adds the in-scope suppressed line as a second disqualifier). No `sending SIG... to process` line and no escalation line is in scope and oomd_notices is 0, so there is no positive evidence (round-26/contract.md:97-98); an active earlyoom with scope_complete false is KILLERS_UNKNOWN exit 2 (round-26/contract.md:99-101). earlyoom.state is active because the show text carries ActiveState=active (round-26/contract.md:91; the same mapping frozen in cases.json c01/c04/c13). earlyoom.version is 1.9.0 because the version line is in scope (round-26/contract.md:82 with :78-79). earlyoom.dryrun is false because no `dryrun mode enabled` line is in scope and the output spec gives dryrun no null alternative (round-26/contract.md:89 and :94; frozen cases.json c01/c19). oomd.state inactive and oomd.notices_this_boot 0 follow the oomd show text and the oomd_notices input (round-26/contract.md:95; frozen cases.json c01/c06). Deliberately not pinned: earlyoom.grammar, because round-26/contract.md:91 lists the two grammar values but states no condition for choosing between them, and the two readings that fit the frozen set (verified when the in-scope version line reads 1.9.0, versus verified only for a complete scope) disagree exactly for this input; earlyoom.actions, because frozen case c05 declines to pin the counts of an active reader whose scope is incomplete; earlyoom.thresholds, because round-26/contract.md:92 gives thresholds a null alternative and frozen case c04, also an incomplete scope, leaves thresholds unpinned; earlyoom.earlier_invocation_send_lines, because the contract does not decide its value for a boot with no earlier invocation.

A2-01 carries the qualifier 'in scope', so a suppressed line from before the current invocation starts must not fire the rule. The journal holds `Suppressed 17 messages from earlyoom.service` at 73499999, one microsecond before ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic=73500000, and the version line `earlyoom 1.9.0` at 73500000 (main.c:161 at earlyoom v1.9.0). Scope is the current invocation's lines in the current boot whose __MONOTONIC_TIMESTAMP is >= ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic (round-26/contract.md:78-79), so the suppressed line at 73499999 is outside the scope; rule A2-01 (round-27/contract.md:49; round-26/contract.md:158-159) fires only on a suppressed line in scope, so the version line of the current invocation, which is inside the scope, leaves scope_complete true (round-26/contract.md:92-93). Every other field pinned here is the same pairing that frozen case c19 pins for a version-line-only journal: version 1.9.0 and the verified 1.9.0 grammar (round-26/contract.md:82 and :91), thresholds null and the dry-run flag unset because no threshold line and no `dryrun mode enabled` line is in scope (round-26/contract.md:89 and :92). With no action line in scope and oomd_notices 0 there is no positive evidence (round-26/contract.md:97-98) and nothing forces the unknown verdict (round-26/contract.md:99-101), so the verdict is KILLERS_QUIET exit 0 (round-26/contract.md:102-104). oomd.state inactive and oomd.notices_this_boot 0 follow the oomd show text and the oomd_notices input (round-26/contract.md:95; frozen cases.json c19). Deliberately not pinned: earlyoom.actions, because round-26/contract.md:102 reserves actions null for an inactive or absent killer and frozen case c19 also leaves the counts of an action-free journal unpinned; earlyoom.earlier_invocation_send_lines, because the contract does not decide its value for a boot with no earlier invocation, and a suppressed line is neither a send line nor an escalation line (round-26/contract.md:176).

A2-01 next to positive evidence: the in-scope suppressed line still makes the scope incomplete, but the positive evidence stands and the verdict does not fall back to unknown. The version line `earlyoom 1.9.0` is at 88000000, exactly ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic=88000000, and `Suppressed 3 messages from earlyoom.service` at 88000050 is later, so both are inside the scope (round-26/contract.md:78-79); rule A2-01 (round-27/contract.md:49; round-26/contract.md:158-159) then sets scope_complete false (round-26/contract.md:92-93). The third record, `sending SIGTERM to process 5151 "imaginary-burrower"` at 88000100, is the kill.c:627 form `sending %s to process %d ...` with only the invented process name kept and no uid and no command line, so it is one in-scope SIGTERM action (round-26/contract.md:85) and it is positive evidence that stands even when the scope is incomplete (round-26/contract.md:97-98); hence KILLER_ACTED exit 1 and not the unknown verdict of round-26/contract.md:99-101. The action counts are printed as counts even for an incomplete scope (round-26/contract.md:93-94; the same pairing frozen in cases.json c04, which pins actions.sigterm 1 and actions.sigkill 0 with scope_complete false), so sigterm is 1 and sigkill is 0. earlyoom.state is active because the show text carries ActiveState=active (round-26/contract.md:91). earlyoom.version is 1.9.0 because the version line is in scope (round-26/contract.md:82 with :78-79). earlyoom.dryrun is false because no `dryrun mode enabled` line is in scope and the output spec gives dryrun no null alternative (round-26/contract.md:89 and :94). oomd is active but reports no notice this boot, so oomd.state is active and oomd.notices_this_boot is 0 (round-26/contract.md:95; frozen cases.json c10/c28), and oomd contributes no positive evidence, so the verdict rests on the earlyoom action line alone. Deliberately not pinned: earlyoom.grammar, because round-26/contract.md:91 states no condition for choosing between verified-1.9.0 and unverified and the readings that fit the frozen set disagree for an incomplete scope; earlyoom.thresholds, because round-26/contract.md:92 gives thresholds a null alternative and frozen case c04 leaves thresholds unpinned; earlyoom.earlier_invocation_send_lines, because the contract does not decide its value for a boot with no earlier invocation.

Rule A2-02 decides the earlyoom state and the verdict; the other pinned fields are decided by the base contract for this input. State: round-26/contract.md:162-163 (Amendment A2, rule A2b adopted) says 'an ActiveState other than active or inactive (failed, activating, deactivating, reloading, maintenance) maps to state unavailable and KILLERS_UNKNOWN', and the same rule is row A2-02 of the frozen table at round-27/contract.md:50. The show text here carries ActiveState=failed, so earlyoom.state is unavailable; 'unavailable' is one of the four legal states at round-26/contract.md:90. Verdict and exit: round-26/contract.md:99 gives 'KILLERS_UNKNOWN, exit 2'. No positive evidence exists, so the KILLER_ACTED clause of round-26/contract.md:97 (an in-scope 'sending SIG... to process' line, an escalation line, or oomd_notices > 0) cannot fire: the journal holds no such line and oomd_notices is 0. scope_complete: ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic=0 leaves the invocation unbounded, so scope_complete is false (round-26/contract.md:173-174, the same rule as round-27/contract.md:53). The oomd side is readable and steady (ActiveState=inactive), so oomd.state is inactive and the notice count is 0 (round-26/contract.md:95 lists oomd.state and oomd.notices_this_boot; the frozen case c06 in tools/fixtures/mori-oom-killers/cases.json pins this exact mapping and count for this show shape). Journal shapes are upstream earlyoom v1.9.0: 'Started Early OOM Daemon.' is a systemd unit line outside the grammar (round-26/contract.md:80-89; the same line appears in the frozen case c01), the version line is main.c:161, the threshold line is main.c:414 with PRIPCT '%5.2lf%%' (msg.h:10) and the failed-kill line is kill.c:654 ('kill failed: ' plus strerror). The kill failed line is not positive evidence under round-26/contract.md:97, which counts only send and escalation lines, so the verdict stays KILLERS_UNKNOWN; the frozen case c16 pins the same shape as non-positive evidence. Not pinned because the contract does not decide them for a non-active earlyoom: earlyoom.version, earlyoom.grammar, earlyoom.thresholds, earlyoom.actions (round-26/contract.md:102 fixes actions null for an inactive or absent killer only, and the frozen unavailable-state case c25 pins none), earlyoom.dryrun.

cases.why: The quietest shape of the same rule: a transitional earlyoom state with nothing logged this boot, so the state mapping alone decides the outcome. State: ActiveState=activating is named in the rule at round-26/contract.md:162-163 and round-27/contract.md:50, so earlyoom.state is unavailable even though the unit is loaded and enabled and the show read succeeded. The journal is an empty list, not null: null means the read failed (round-26/contract.md:73; the frozen null journal case c08), while an empty list is a successful read with no record, so this case is neither the null read path nor the frozen inactive case c06. Verdict and exit: no positive evidence exists under round-26/contract.md:97 (no send line, no escalation line, oomd_notices 0), so round-26/contract.md:99 gives KILLERS_UNKNOWN with exit 2. scope_complete: ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic=0 leaves the invocation unbounded, so scope_complete is false (round-26/contract.md:173-174, the same rule as round-27/contract.md:53). The oomd unit is readable and inactive, so oomd.state is inactive and the notice count is 0 (round-26/contract.md:95; the frozen case c06 pins the same mapping and count for this shape). Not pinned because the contract does not decide them for a non-active earlyoom: earlyoom.version, earlyoom.grammar, earlyoom.thresholds, earlyoom.actions (round-26/contract.md:102 fixes actions null for an inactive or absent killer only), earlyoom.dryrun; and with an empty journal there is no version line to decide a version or a grammar from (round-26/contract.md:82).

Rule A2-03 (round-27 contract.md:51; round-26 contract.md:164-165): `killing whole process group ` lines are counted in earlyoom.process_group_lines, and every count is a count of earlyoom log lines, not of processes signalled or killed. The group line here is the upstream rendering of kill.c:282, `warn("killing whole process group %d (-g flag is active)\n", res)`, with the invented group id 5507; the group id is invented and no uid, name or command line is carried. The line sits one microsecond after the SIGTERM send line of kill.c:627 and both are inside the scope, because round-26 contract.md:78 scopes earlyoom lines to a timestamp at or after ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic=20500000, so process_group_lines is 1. The send line is an action line and the group line is not, so the action counts follow only the two action prefixes of round-26 contract.md:85: sigterm 1, sigkill 0; no escalation, kill failed or low memory line is present either (round-26 contract.md:86-88). The version line of main.c:161 is at exactly 20500000, inside the scope, so scope_complete is true and the version parses to 1.9.0, so grammar is verified-1.9.0 (round-26 contract.md:90, :82). The threshold lines of main.c:414 and main.c:416 are inside the scope and PRIPCT (msg.h:10) renders 20.00 and 10.00 without a pad space, so the thresholds are 20.0, 20.0, 10.0 and 10.0 (round-26 contract.md:83-84). No `dryrun mode enabled` line (main.c:295) is present, so dryrun is false (round-26 contract.md:89). The in scope send line is positive evidence, so the verdict is KILLER_ACTED exit 1 (round-26 contract.md:97). The oomd side is inactive with 0 notices, so it contributes no evidence (round-26 contract.md:95, :97).
